title: EducatesEKSConfig
description: EKS production scenario. BundledCertManager+ACME(DNS01/Route53) + BundledContour(LoadBalancer) + BundledExternalDNS(Route53) + BundledKyverno. IRSA throughout.

apiVersion.description: API version of the configuration kind. Always cli.educates.dev/v1alpha1.

aws.description: AWS account, region and IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA) settings. cert-manager and external-dns authenticate to AWS through these roles, so no static credentials are stored.

accountId.description: Twelve-digit AWS account ID. Used to derive default IAM role ARNs when they are not set explicitly.

region.description: AWS region the cluster runs in and where Route53 operations are performed.

route53HostedZoneId.description: Route53 hosted zone ID for the ingress domain. external-dns and the cert-manager DNS01 solver operate within this zone.

certManagerRoleARN.description: IAM role ARN the cert-manager workload assumes via IRSA. Empty defaults to a role derived from accountId.

externalDNSRoleARN.description: IAM role ARN the external-dns workload assumes via IRSA. Empty defaults to a role derived from accountId.

domain.description: Wildcard ingress domain Educates serves workshops under. external-dns publishes records for it in the Route53 hosted zone.

acme.description: ACME issuer settings for the wildcard certificate. Required unless externalTLSTermination is set. The DNS01 solver and Route53 provider are fixed by this kind; only the account email and directory URL are configurable.

email.description: Contact email registered with the ACME server (for example Let's Encrypt).

server.description: ACME directory URL. Empty defaults to Let's Encrypt production; set it to the staging directory while testing.

externalTLSTermination.description: Asserts TLS for the ingress domain is terminated outside the cluster (external load balancer or proxy forwarding plain HTTP inward). Educates issues no in-cluster certificate and generated portal and workshop URLs use https. Maps to EducatesClusterConfig ingress.protocol https with a None certificates provider; acme is not required when set.

clusterAdmin.description: Grant workshop sessions cluster-admin access. Disabled by default on production clusters.

lookupService.description: Deploy the lookup service used for service discovery across training portals. Enabled by default.

imagePrePuller.description: Pre-pull workshop images onto every node ahead of time so session startup is not blocked on image pulls. Enabled by default.

websiteStyling.description: Customisation of the workshop dashboard and training portal appearance.

defaultTheme.description: Name of the theme applied to workshop sessions and portals by default.

themeDataRefs.description: Secrets holding theme data (CSS, HTML, JavaScript) to load into the cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret holding the theme data.

name.description: Name of the Secret holding the theme data.

secretPropagation.description: Secrets to copy into workshop session namespaces.

imagePullSecretNames.description: Names of image pull Secrets to make available to workshop sessions.

imageVersions.description: Per-component image overrides. Each entry points a named platform component at a specific image.

name.description: Component name to override, for example session-manager or training-portal.

image.description: Full image reference (repository and tag) to use for the component.

operator.description: Settings for the Educates installer operator deployment.

image.description: Image used for the installer operator. Defaults to the image matching the CLI version.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. When empty the chart derives it: Always for floating tags, IfNotPresent otherwise.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of image pull Secrets the operator deployment should use.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity for the operator and platform components.
